constraints: For selection-type list boxes, the list box object's own data source is an internal reference and cannot be modified or read this way.
Data source changes for list box columns must be consistent with the list box type (e.g. a field cannot be used as an array-type list box column's source).
Does nothing if applied to a data source that is not modifiable.

params.name: dataSource
params.description: Pointer to the field or variable to use as the object's new data source.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Modifies the field/variable data source represented by the designated form object at runtime.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by '*'.
